prompt:
Use the reference image for the world, lighting and character design language: the same wooden table, warm lantern-lit Chongqing restaurant, the same big round dark iron hotpot with glossy red chili broth and its food characters, and the same character style (googly eyes with white eyeballs and black pupils, small toothless mouths, tiny arms and legs made of the ingredient's own material, photorealistic textures). New shot on the table next to the hotpot, vertical 9:16, camera about 35 degrees above, medium-wide framing. Foreground center: a small round rustic ceramic dipping bowl (Chongqing oil dish) filled with clear golden sesame oil, glossy and shimmering, the whole bowl fully visible. In the background, the big hotpot steams and bubbles, slightly out of focus, with its characters (beef roll, tripe, duck blood, tofu, chilies) visible and peeking over the pot rim toward the bowl. On the rim of the oil bowl, a line of little divers stands in a row ready to jump in like a synchronized diving team: three peeled garlic cloves (creamy ivory, smooth, slightly glossy) and three short pieces of green scallion (bright green hollow rings/segments), each with googly eyes, small toothless mouths and tiny arms and legs. The first garlic clove is mid-air diving gracefully into the oil with arms stretched forward, a small golden splash beginning; the others stand on the rim, arms up ready; the last garlic clove at the end of the line looks nervous, and the scallion behind it is about to give it a little push. Warm tungsten light, golden oil highlights, shallow depth of field, cute food-character animation in a photorealistic style, appetizing, film grain. No comic motion lines or symbols, no humans, no human hands, no text, no logos.
画面要求：背景不透明，纸面或底色铺满整个画面，不要透明、镂空或黑色边角区域。
